overlap: Framingham cross-sectional and longitudinal results share participants and are not independent replications.
Hoorn first wave in hoorn2020 overlaps the Hoorn component of direct2017; the second wave is a separately recruited cohort.
SHIP-0 participation excluded SHIP-Trend eligibility: independent participants from the same region.
DASA laboratory database is independent of PNS; geographic overlap is not shared sampling.
unresolved: Neither target has a fully identified distribution conditional on exactly the visible covariates.
Insulin models require unavailable waist, insulin clearance/sensitivity, lipid or activity covariates, and log-scale normalization/intercept/residual law.
Taiwan raw-scale glucose correlation does not identify a coefficient adjusted for BMI/sex/age. Insulin-tertile summaries cannot be reversed without a joint model.
MACAD IQR values are widths, not endpoints or SDs; logarithm base not stated. No lognormal assumption or conversion applied.
SHIP Table 3 upper limits conflict with the abstract and paragraph Par23; Table 3 retained verbatim pending independent admission.
SHIP spline coefficients omitted because numerical spline basis/knots are not available in the table.
HbA1c mixture of known/unknown diabetes and treatment is not identified from age/sex/BMI; healthy-source truncation cannot calibrate the general-population upper tail.
HbA1c BMI/sex associations conditional on glucose and waist/hip differ from marginal associations. No desired sign was imposed.
DIRECT predicts a future outcome and needs additional variables; it is optional context, not a drop-in contemporaneous generator.
No unit conversions, source statistical harmonization, or target adaptation were performed.
